brief:
French footballer Paul Pogba posted on Instagram in support of Gaza, sharing a photograph of a Palestinian child standing amid the rubble and destruction caused by the war in the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The image showed the young Palestinian surrounded by the devastation left behind by military operations in the enclave.

Pogba published the photograph to his official Instagram account as a gesture of solidarity with residents of Gaza facing the ongoing conflict. The post underscored the footballer's public stance on the humanitarian situation unfolding in the territory as the war continues to displace civilians and damage infrastructure across the densely populated coastal enclave.
